name: Sakura Biyori
source:
Main character is accepted as a teacher to the school of his dream - the school where he studied with his childhood friends. The students there are as cheerful as ever. But a black shadow aims at the school. Can protagonist protect the students! ?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被梦寐以求的学校录用为教师——那正是他曾与青梅竹马一同就读的学校。那里的学生依然一如既往地开朗。然而，一道黑影正瞄准学校。主人公能保护学生们吗！？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
